senses.gloss:
व्ली व्ली (also written ब्ली; according to
some fr. वि-ली, but cf. rt. व्री), cl. 9. P. व्लि-
नाति (Ved. व्लीनाति^1), विव्लाय, व्लेष्यति, अव्लैषीत्,
व्लेतुम्, to go, move; to choose, select, (in this sense
for rts. वृ, व्री); to hold, maintain, support: Caus.
व्लेपयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्लिपत्: Desid. विव्ली-
षति: Intens. वेव्लीयते, वेव्लयीति or वेव्लेति.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161213. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/322, batch 316-318.
व्लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; held, supported.
